findings.summary: The axis label "Share [%]" names the unit but not what the share is of, while the two series carry different denominators: the grey series is the mean first-response parse success per request and the blue series is delivered signals per cohort signal (raw_parse_rate over batches, delivery_rate over the 200-signal cohort at scripts/refine_signal_enrichment.py:159-178). A reader seeing the plot without its caption can read the grey-to-blue gap as one conversion of the same population when a single request covers up to ten signals. Nothing is hidden in the published artifact — the evidence caption already states that parsing is measured per request and coverage per signal — so this does not hold the node; naming the denominators in the two series labels or the axis label would let the figure stand on its own.
